description: DE-Pack: declining balance for new residential buildings — 5 % of the residual value, for acquisitions between 1 October 2023 and 30 September 2029 (§ 7 Abs. 5a EStG). This is the second declining-balance regime the German pack carries, and its window overlaps the one for movables (§ 7 Abs. 2 EStG, mid-2025 to end of 2027), so on a date in 2026 both are in force. The pack tells them apart by asset class; the core's rule is that a class-specific entry wins over a general one whatever the file order. Without it the building falls into the movables entry, where the 30 % cap does not even bind at this life: 3 x 2.9412 % = 8.8235 %, so 35,294.00 instead of 20,000.00 in the first year, with nothing to indicate anything went wrong. The useful life comes with the acquisition rather than from the pack's table on purpose: for a residential building the straight-line rate depends on the year of completion (3 % since 2023, 2 % before), and the table has no date dimension, so tabling one figure would be wrong for every older building. 400,000.00 over 400 months: min(3 x 2.9412 %, 5 %) = 5 %.
